title: ACUPUNCTURE · CONNECTED CARE
text: A practical walkthrough of the actual website. Use fictional sample details only. This video has on-screen instructions and no audio.

title: 01 / CREATE A PATIENT ACCOUNT
text: Choose Patient → Create a patient account. Use your name, email and a password of at least 12 characters.

title: 01 / CREATE A PATIENT ACCOUNT
text: Acknowledge the sample-data notice, then create your account. No gender selection is required.

title: 02 / YOUR ASSIGNED PRACTITIONER
text: A sample doctor is assigned automatically. Jamie is assigned to Dr. Arun Patel, doctor02@example.com, ID ACU-DEMO-002.

title: 03 / EXPLORE 40 SAMPLE DOCTORS
text: The directory contains 40 fictional practitioners. Search by name, practice area or ID. These are not real provider listings.

title: 03 / FIND YOUR DOCTOR
text: The assigned doctor is marked in the directory. ID and email identify the account, but a password and clinic approval are also required.

title: 04 / YOUR INTAKE — GENDER IS OPTIONAL
text: The original 107 intake questions are retained across seven sections. Leave Gender at “Prefer not to answer” if you wish.

title: 04 / OPTIONAL SENSITIVE QUESTIONS
text: Reproductive-health questions are hidden until you choose to answer them. You can skip this section regardless of gender.

title: 04 / DESCRIBE YOUR EXPERIENCE
text: The front/back pain map supports clicking or keyboard coordinates. This records symptoms; it does not suggest acupuncture points.

title: 04 / SAVE OR SUBMIT
text: Use Save draft to return later, or acknowledge and Submit intake. Saved information remains available after you sign out.

title: 05 / REQUEST AN APPOINTMENT
text: Select a future date and time in clinic local time. A request is not a confirmed appointment, and no email is sent.

title: 05 / YOUR REQUEST IS SAVED
text: Your assigned practitioner can confirm the request in their workspace. Duplicate time requests for the same doctor are rejected.

title: 06 / KEEP QUESTIONS TOGETHER
text: Use Doctor suggestions for follow-up messages. Messages are saved, but are not monitored for emergencies and send no notification.

title: 07 / YOUR UPLOADED MERIDIAN IMAGE
text: Your original reference image is included, alongside searchable meridian names, abbreviations, colors and point counts.

title: 07 / A REFERENCE, NOT A TREATMENT GUIDE
text: Search by name or code. This library is educational only, not a diagnosis or self-needling instruction.

title: 08 / DOCTOR SIGN-IN
text: For Jamie’s assigned sample doctor: doctor02@example.com · ACU-DEMO-002 · DemoCare!2026. Real applicants must first be verified by the clinic.

title: 08 / A FOCUSED PRACTITIONER WORKSPACE
text: Doctors can access only patients assigned to them. Review intake, manage appointment requests and publish consultation records.

title: 09 / REVIEW THE PATIENT’S STORY
text: Choose an assigned patient. Their saved intake and past consultation records are shown alongside the new care-record form.

title: 09 / RECORD CLEAR, SEPARATE VISITS
text: Enter assessment, doctor suggestions, optional prescription, treatment and follow-up. Optional meridian labels link to the reference image.

title: 09 / PUBLISH TO THE PATIENT’S HISTORY
text: A published visit becomes visible to the patient. Records are append-only: add a clearly labelled correction rather than overwriting history.

title: 10 / CONFIRM THE VISIT
text: The assigned practitioner confirms the request. Status changes are saved and visible to the patient.

title: 11 / REPLY TO FOLLOW-UP QUESTIONS
text: Patient questions and practitioner replies stay together in the same saved conversation. Consultation records stay in Care history.

title: 12 / RETURN AS THE PATIENT
text: Sign back in using the same patient email and password. Care history now contains the doctor’s published consultation.

title: 12 / SEE PAST PRESCRIPTIONS & SUGGESTIONS
text: Expand the prescription and follow-up sections. Search older records, sort by date, or print your care history.

title: 12 / YOUR FOLLOW-UP REPLY IS SAVED
text: The patient can review the doctor’s saved reply even after signing out and coming back.

title: 13 / ACCOUNT & RECORD EXPORT
text: My account lets patients export records as JSON and change their password. There is no connected email or password-reset service.

title: READY TO EXPLORE
text: Open the HTML for a device-only demo. Run the included Python server for connected accounts. Public hosting and a clinical security/privacy review are required before real patient use.
